blocks.text: Episode 78 begins in Anandpur Sahib with a domestic request that becomes a spiritual test when a Sikh tells Guru Gobind Singh, I need a house made in brick and mortar, asking for durable security.
The Guru answers paradoxically rather than practically, instructing the man to set his thatched house on fire before expecting anything more permanent to arise.
That shocking command gives the page its point: the house made in brick and mortar is not granted through caution alone, but through a willingness to obey first and understand later.
